answer: Sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent pays a non-refundable 40-credit fee, like cutting quartz: the cost is sunk whether the crystal sells or not. Verification checks payment plus one work record. Minting 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 credits, far above the few hundred a fake could earn, so the attack stops before the summit of the market. A river of fakes narrows to one paid channel. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
